verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents its own region selection: you can pin an agent or MCP server to a specific region via the region field in blaxel.toml. However, the docs say region choice is only available 'sometimes' and describe it as a deployment/compute setting, not an explicit data-storage residency guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency guarantees for stored data (volumes, Agent Drive, snapshots), region choice across all resource types such as sandboxes and jobs, a documented list of available regions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: you can optionally pin an agent or MCP server to a specific region by setting the region field in your blaxel.toml
When deploying a resource on Blaxel, you sometimes have the option to choose the deployment region.
